from: After F12, the coefficient-prime-not-p rank-linear H1 estimate for arbitrary metabelian monodromy remained, with no fixed conductor or bounded ramified covering degree in the proved gate
to: After one fixed cover, all those systems have fixed logarithmic conductor bounds; monomiality reduces their H1 to rank-one characters on etale resolution covers, and removal of unramified order reduces the remaining geometric estimate to cyclic covers of one uniformly bounded p-power degree
evidence: work/fhi/F_metabelian_log_conductor.tex, F_bounded_cyclic_reduction.tex, F_swan_residue_gap.tex; root audits work/root/F13_audit.md (after review03) and work/root/audits_08.md. F13.6 is the explicit still-unproved degree-linear tame-generator estimate for those bounded cyclic covers. The general complete-local Betti bound, unrestricted derived-length-three case and full conjecture are not marked proved.
